agent_utilization.definition: active agent-steps / (agents * episode steps); an agent-step is active if the agent is active at the end of the step and not idle on base (stayed on the base and started the step at full energy)

agents_disabled.definition: distinct agents disabled during the episode (equals disablement events: an agent is disabled at most once)

coverage_sensed.definition: eligible cells ever inside an active agent's sensor footprint (including at reset) / eligible cells; eligible = not STRUCTURE and reachable from the base by at least one agent type in the roster

coverage_visited.definition: eligible cells ever occupied by any agent / eligible cells

energy_used.definition: sum of action energy spent (energy_spent events); recharge not subtracted; hazard damage excluded

false_positive_reports.definition: number of reports of cells without a survivor

hazard_energy_lost.definition: sum of energy_lost over hazard exposures

hazard_exposures.definition: number of hazard_exposure events (agent-steps ending in a hazard)

invalid_actions.definition: number of masked actions submitted by policies (executed as STAY; ADR-0004)

mission_success.definition: episode ended with end_reason mission_success (global recall reached recall_target)
mission_success.undefined_when: zero survivors, or the stream has no episode_end

move_conflicts.definition: number of move_conflict events (vertex, swap or blocked moves; ADR-0003)

precision.definition: distinct reported cells containing a survivor / distinct reported cells (all agents, all steps; duplicates collapse to one location)

reachable_recall.definition: |found survivors on eligible cells| / |survivors on eligible cells|
reachable_recall.undefined_when: no survivor on an eligible cell

recall.definition: |found survivors| / |all survivors|; found = at least one true report; unreachable survivors stay in the denominator

report_precision.definition: true reports / all reports (every step-agent-cell report counts)

time_to_first_detection.definition: step index of the first true report

time_to_recall_target.definition: step index at which the episode ended in mission success
